full_prompt_en: The image is a square landscape painting of a broad summer meadow under a clear blue sky. Golden grass fills most of the foreground and rises in rolling slopes toward the right side. The nearest grass is built from many small yellow, ocher, and muted green strokes, giving the field a dry, slightly rough surface. Pale rocks sit among the grass at lower right and on the far slope, their cool highlights distinct against the warm ground. A darker green hollow begins from the lower left and draws the eye toward a narrow blue strip of water in the middle distance. Large leafy trees cluster along the left edge, forming a deep almost black-green mass with irregular crowns. Smaller trees mark the far center and the top of the right slope. At the distant crest, tiny warm-roofed forms appear among the tree line. The sky is saturated blue near the top and lighter toward the horizon; a few small white clouds drift above the land. Bright sunlight illuminates the grass and pale rocks, while the trees hold dense cool shade. The painterly transitions are not slick: separate short brush marks and patches of undercolor remain visible throughout the field and foliage. The broad land forms are simple and legible from a distance, but close viewing reveals many shifts of green and gold. The horizon lies in the upper third, leaving the meadow enough space to become the primary experience of the image. No person or animal interrupts the quiet scene. The composition balances the dark tree wall on the left with open sunlit slopes on the right, and uses the low distant water as a small cool interval between them. The result is calm, spacious, and grounded in observed daylight.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形风景油画，宽阔夏日草甸位于晴朗蓝天下。金黄色草地占据前景大半，并向右侧起伏上升。最近的草由许多黄色、赭色和暗绿色短笔触构成，给田野干燥而略粗糙的表面。浅色石块散在右下草间和远处坡地上，其冷亮面与暖地面分明。较深的绿色洼地从左下开始，把视线引向中远处一条狭窄蓝色水面。高大的阔叶树聚在左边，形成近乎黑绿的深色体块，树冠边缘不规则。较小树木标记远处中央与右侧坡顶。远方山脊上，树林间露出些微暖色屋顶形状。天空顶部蓝色饱和，向地平线渐浅；几朵小白云飘在陆地上方。明亮日光照亮草与浅色石块，树群则保持浓厚冷影。绘画过渡并不光滑，草地和树叶中仍可看到分开的短笔痕及底色斑块。大地形从远处看简明清楚，近看却有许多绿与金的变化。地平线位于上三分之一处，给草地足够篇幅成为主要体验。没有人物或动物打断安静场景。构图以左侧深色树墙平衡右侧开放阳光坡地，用远处低矮的水面作两者之间一小段冷色停顿。画面平静、宽阔，建立在对日光的观察之上。
style_prompt_en: Naturalistic landscape painting uses short visible strokes and mottled undercolor to describe broad land forms. Sunlit ocher and gold cover large open passages, while layered dark greens supply compact shaded masses. Clear blue sky and small light clouds provide a cool upper field. Edges remain irregular and painterly, particularly where foliage meets the sky or grass passes around stones. Light is direct and bright, but the surface keeps its granular, hand-painted variation instead of becoming smooth. A low sequence of slopes, hollows, and distant color bands gives depth through changing scale and tone. The overall atmosphere is quiet, spacious, and closely observed, with warm open ground set against cool dense shade.
style_prompt_zh: 自然主义风景画以可见短笔触和斑驳底色描绘宽阔地形。阳光下的赭与金覆盖开放的大片区域，叠加的深绿形成紧凑阴影体块。清蓝天空和少量浅云提供上方冷色域。边缘不规则而有绘画感，尤其是叶群接天处和草绕石块处。光直接明亮，表面却保持颗粒状手绘变化，没有变得平滑。坡地、洼处和远方色带的低矮序列通过尺度与调子变化形成纵深。整体安静、宽阔且观察入微，以暖开放地面衬托冷而密的阴影。
theme_en: A sunlit golden meadow rolling toward dark trees and a distant blue water strip
theme_zh: 阳光下的金色草甸向深色树群和远处蓝色水面起伏
name: Isaac Levitan
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
